Appel en direct à l'API Search Console (: Live call to the Search Console API (no page × query data already stored) — limited to 50 queries.
Part des clics et des impressions selon: Share of clicks and impressions by the average position of each query (computed on all the month's queries, not only the top). Positions 4-10 are the quickest opportunity: one more page in the top 3 changes the click volume.
Toutes les requêtes · mois touchés par l: All queries · months covered by the period
La distribution des positions arrive ave: The position distribution arrives with the next data refresh.
Clics, impressions, CTR et position moye: Clicks, impressions, CTR and average position of organic search by device. Mobile and desktop do not have the same position: a large gap points to a usability or content issue specific to a device.
Search Console · mois touchés par la pér: Search Console · months covered by the period
Les données par appareil arrivent avec l: Data by device arrives with the next data refresh.
Les clics sur des requêtes qui contienne: Clicks on queries that contain the brand name (“peugeot trade-in”) come from people who already knew the brand; non-brand measures real acquisition (“car valuation”). Ranking over all the month's queries.
Requêtes contenant le nom de la marque ·: Queries containing the brand name · months covered by the period
Le classement marque / hors marque arriv: The brand / non-brand ranking arrives with the next data refresh.
Top des requêtes Search Console par clic: Top Search Console queries by clicks over the period. The badges compare each row with the other rows displayed: clicks and impressions (green above the median, orange between the first quartile and the median, red below), CTR compared with the expected CTR at that position, position (1 to 3 green, 4 to 10 orange, beyond red).
Écart de clics de chaque requête entre l: Change in clicks for each query between the last month analysed in the period and the previous month (all the month's queries). Queries that rise as well as those that fall should be linked to changes in content, page or offer.
Les requêtes gagnantes et perdantes arri: Winning and losing queries arrive with the next data refresh.
Requêtes classées entre la 4e et la 15e: Queries ranked between 4th and 15th position with at least 100 impressions and a CTR below that of a top 3 position (≈ 10%). The gain is the number of additional clicks per month if the query moved into the top 3 (impressions × (10% − current CTR)). Indicative estimate, not a forecast.
Les opportunités SEO arrivent avec le pr: SEO opportunities arrive with the next data refresh.
Requêtes (au moins 200 impressions) pour: Queries (at least 200 impressions) for which several pages of the site share the impressions, each accounting for at least 5% of the query's impressions. When two pages compete for the same query, Google hesitates and neither rises: a single page should carry each query.
Aucune cannibalisation détectée sur cett: No cannibalization detected on this selection (or the data arrives with the next refresh).
Pages de la propriété Search Console par: Pages of the Search Console property by clicks. Bounce, GA4 Leads and Conv. come from GA4: bounce is measured per page view; leads attach each valuation request to the session's landing page, and Conv. = leads ÷ the page's landing sessions (shown from 100 sessions).
Search Console rapproché de GA4 par URL: Search Console matched with GA4 by URL
Rebond, Leads GA4 et Conv. proviennent d: Bounce, GA4 Leads and Conv. come from GA4, matched by page. GA4 Leads and Conv. follow the channel chosen above and attach each valuation request to the session's landing page (the entry page), not to the form page. “—” indicates insufficient traffic (< 100 landing sessions) or the home page “/”, shared by the parent site and the trade-in site and therefore not attributable.
Pages dont les clics baissent entre le d: Pages whose clicks fall between the last month analysed in the period and the previous month (at least 10 clicks the previous month), with the change in their average position. A page that loses clicks while keeping its position has a CTR issue (title, description); one that loses position has a content or competition issue.
Aucune page en déclin sur cette sélectio: No declining page on this selection (or the data arrives with the next refresh).
Pour les pages principales : clics Searc: For the main pages: Search Console clicks, GA4 sessions that started on the page (Organic Search channel) and valuations triggered. The match is made by URL; “/” is excluded (home page shared by the parent site and the trade-in tool).
Pas encore de rapprochement GA4 par page: No GA4 match by page yet on this selection.
Contrôle Google (API URL Inspection) des: Google check (URL Inspection API) of the 10 most clicked pages of each site, once a week: is the page indexed, when was it crawled, does Google keep the same canonical URL as the one declared? A main page that is not indexed disappears from search.
Interrogation directe de Search Console: Direct Search Console query for two periods of your choice: the day-by-day detail is not stored, it is read on demand.
Choisis une dimension et des dates : app: Choose a dimension and dates: live call to Search Console, day-by-day data
Les mises à jour de tes tickets depuis t: Updates to your tickets since your last visit
Signaler un bug dans les données, demand: Report a data bug, request an improvement, ask a question
Moyennes et problèmes communs sur les si: Averages and common problems across the selected sites (all by default), based on each site's latest PageSpeed reading. Lighthouse lab scores; field data (INP) is only available for sites with enough traffic.
Scores par palier, puis métriques moyenn: Scores by bracket, then average metrics against Lighthouse thresholds
Problèmes les plus répandus, classés par: Most widespread problems, ranked by estimated total gain
Score moyen, des plus lentes aux plus ra: Average score, from slowest to fastest
Les 5 plus bas scores du périmètre, avec: The 5 lowest scores in the scope, with their LCP
Scores Lighthouse de l'outil de reprise: Lighthouse scores of the trade-in tool measured via the PageSpeed Insights API (median of 3 measurements per site and per device). Weekly measurement, not daily: a site's performance varies little from one day to the next.
Texte prêt à coller · rien n'est créé da: Text ready to paste · nothing is created in Jira
Leads du back-office (extraction BO) hor: Back-office leads (BO extraction) excluding duplicates, tests and non-production leads. A measure distinct from GA4 Leads: the BO also counts requests that GA4 does not see (consent, blockers).
Projection des leads valides du périmètr: Projection of the scope's valid leads: actual since January + rest of the year based on last year's days × the growth of the last 90 days. Tested on 2022-2025 (entire network): gap of −0.6% to +1.1% on the annual total.
Réel, projection et fourchette, comparés: Actual, projection and range, compared with last year
Leads valides par mois, trois dernières: Valid leads per month, last three years, based on the deep back-office history (data/leads_mensuel.json). The gap shown above the months is that of the current year against the previous one, complete months only.
